posts.community: E-pack durables - ODM worth a serious look
posts.text: I believe there is quite the value in this one right now. Market has butchered the stock price and it’s now around IPO level prices. 2025 was a bad summer and growth in June was not enough to change PAT and EBITDA due to their large capex and fixed cost rise. The picture looks ugly, but that is when any change can greatly help the share price.
